skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Snowy Plains in Words
skins.content: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/Snowy Plains in Words. The layered fabric keeps the wearer warm, while the closed sleeves and pants keep the wind and snow out.
skins.quote: As line after line appears on the page, Pozëmka's thoughts drift to the night of her flight. The north wind brings the snow, while a bright fire burns in the fireplace. The gas lamp outside the tent flickers, unable to light her unpredictable path.

skins.name: Beside Dreams
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Beside Dreams. A sheer robe woven from Yanese muslin, paired with a magnolia hairpin. Returned to seclusion, brush in hand beside spring's window, the mortal realm meets ethereal dreams.
skins.quote: Stronger drink will not make this fantasy any more real. It is unknown when the moons' light seeped into her dreams. Please pack away these curious thoughts properly, and don't let the Yanese read her half-written work.
